architectureDecisions: D1 -- Wire the six bb081/*.test.mjs files into a new test:bb081 npm script (package.json scripts addition only, no CI workflow mutation); add N1-N5 as node:test cases alongside them.

D2 -- Offline fixture end-to-end: run.mjs fixtureScript (32 registered units) -> report.mjs buildReport -> accept.mjs decide, asserting reducer determinism on both the promotion path (all gates) and the keep-sync path (mutated fault fixture).

D3 -- Dependency binding is checked against the live @exharness/benchmark package root and the real Core public entry via assertComposableCore/assertAllComposable; BB-065 substrate manifest benchmarks/substrate/manifests/terminal-bench-2.1.json is read-only.
D4 -- Repair boundary: a defect found in the bb081 protocol or execution-profile surface is repaired minimally on the exact ref, with regression evidence covering the defect and N1-N5.
implementationSlices: S1 -- Held-out cohort and deterministic decision [C1, C2, N1]: 32-unit identity, DEV_REJECTED, drift detection, six-gate reducer determinism.
S2 -- Fault-ablation safety [C3, N2]: required D cells, duplicateEffects=0, undeclared cells N/A, fault evidence driving the verdict.
S3 -- Publication gating and dependency binding [C4, C5, N3, N4]: evidence binding, STALE, B/C diagnostic-only, mid-flight rollback refusal, manifest contradiction.
S4 -- Reporting integrity [C6, N5]: settlement-required reports, null/UNKNOWN unknowns, offline-fixture labeling.
S5 -- Test wiring + Living Docs: test:bb081 script wiring, BB-081 statements in state/workflow/decisions/architecture, H9 completion.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: registeredUnitIds()/assertRegisteredUnits yield exactly the 32 registered arm units (4 frozen digests x 2 repeats x A/B/C/D); assertHeldOut throws DEV_REJECTED for any non-held-out/DEV/replacement task id, bundle, or digest; assertCohortBinding throws SUBSTRATE_DRIFT/PROTOCOL_DRIFT on any substrate-manifest or protocol-hash change.

decide() returns PROMOTE_ASYNC only on complete 32-unit cohort + complete required D fault evidence + all six primary gates passing; INCONCLUSIVE on missing unit, budget stop, unknown primary accounting, binding/drift invalidity, incomplete fault evidence, or all-eight-D-units zero-detachable; KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE on complete/known evidence with any primary gate conclusively failing; the outcome field asserts Jev cannot override.

dSafetySatisfied() is true only when every required D cell passes AND D duplicateEffects = 0; runFaultMatrix covers exactly the declared cells (assertMatrixComplete); undeclared cells are N/A and never count as pass; mutating a D fixture provably flips decide() to KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE.

getSupportedProfiles() returns only CORE_SYNC unless decision=PROMOTE_ASYNC; createEvidenceBinding throws BINDING for non-PROMOTE_ASYNC decisions or missing ablationProtocolHash/evaluatedSourceSha/dependencyDigest; assertProfilePublishable throws for arms B/C and for CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 without the exact binding; assertEvidenceFresh throws STALE on field drift or digest mismatch; rollbackToSync refuses mid-flight; defaultProfile() stays CORE_SYNC; the public Core entry exposes the full profile contract without changing runtime defaults.

assertDependencyContract throws PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION (never approximates) on missing or mismatched BB-077/078/079/080 refs, accounting vocabulary, transition envelope, or store/checkpoint/coordinator APIs; assertComposableCore/assertAllComposable throw when the public Core entry lacks the required symbols.

buildReport requires every registered attempt settled and fails closed otherwise; buildPairedViews produces exactly 8 matched D/A primary pairs plus A->B/B->C/C->D attribution; unknown provider cost/token/cache stays null/UNKNOWN (never zero-filled); B/C flagged diagnostic-only; offline fixtures labeled dataKind OFFLINE_SCRIPTED_FIXTURE and never become promotion evidence.

A task id, bundle, or digest outside the four reserved held-out digests submitted to the cohort -> assertHeldOut throws DEV_REJECTED; the 32-unit completeness check cannot be satisfied by substitution.
A D cell mutated with duplicateEffects=1 or forceFail -> runFaultCell FAIL, dSafetySatisfied false -> decide() returns KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE (never PROMOTE_ASYNC) over otherwise-complete evidence.

assertEvidenceFresh with a changed evaluatedSourceSha or tampered bindingDigest -> STALE; a subsequent assertProfilePublishable for CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 against the drifted binding is rejected -> no silent async publication.
rollbackToSync with inFlight/unresolved/pendingTurns != 0 -> ROLLBACK refused; detachable-zero D units -> decide() returns INCONCLUSIVE (async path never exercised) rather than inferring promotion.
A D/A pair with null provider cost is recorded as unknown (not zero); unknownPairs>0 -> decide() returns INCONCLUSIVE (missing values stay UNKNOWN).
